name: save-boot-11c-stats-battle-limit-fixed
description: #130: diagnostic for 11a/11b. From "stats-battle", 300 frames with no input, then check, without stopping, that each candidate holds the described limit bars (Cloud 100, Barret 50, Tifa 200): g_BattleWork party[].limitBar at base 0x800F5BB8 (b8_lim, slot 0's metric; slots 1-2 count towards pass/fail only) and at 0x800F5BBC (bc_lim), and the high byte of g_ActiveCharacters[].unk1A (act_lim). mp_battle: g_ActiveCharacters[].mp still equals the described MP (nobody has cast). 1/0 only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
